texts: On day 0 of Year 1, Coraline Ash carried Pell's leather case on the Cliff Path.
Coraline Ash and Pell watched the sky-cat hunt at the East Row from the Middle Row.
Pell told Coraline Ash that surviving nightmoths flee to the dim lanterns of the Hollows.
Coraline Ash wrote the explanation in the notebook.
